scope: Only the final-assessment adapter source and its focused synthetic tests. Fixed saved-target and original-baseline propagation through HostFinalAssessment, protocol admission, queued restart/dispatch and answer completion.

checks.finding: Protocol admission validates the selected package and exact baseline SHA and source_target. A legacy installed protocol cannot admit a saved artifact.
Host configuration is deep-copied; the saved manifest is validated and copied into the fixed ComponentEvaluator. Later target mutation is refused.
Original baseline content is rehashed by CandidateRequest and must match the exact fixed target. Different owner/project/helper/save identities are rejected before scorer or sandbox evaluation.
Saved report path, baseline/candidate SHA, image and command SHA are checked; final binding includes the fixed source-target digest and registration/scorer/file hashes.
Answer completion validates the selected source and retained report/final binding again, then uses the existing report without repeating the runner.
Queue collaborators are assigned before loading retained jobs; saved jobs are checked against current fixed protocols before the dispatcher starts.
Request/replay preserves task, request, scope and frozen registration binding. One independent assessment per registration remains enforced.
Waiting/restarted jobs recheck package artifact hash, path, review ID, baseline, protocol registration and target before dispatch; mismatches fail closed.
Configured host assessment registration and source_target must match protocol configuration. Installed routes retain absent optional target and existing queue/stop/publication behavior.

test_evidence.coverage: Exact baseline/target, coherent foreign source rejection, no-target legacy rejection, immutable target, resealed wrong baseline, one dispatch across restart, changed waiting/restarted target rejection, retained-report tampering, answer completion without rerun, installed component compatibility.

limitations: GO is for this exact source coupling. No runtime installation, newly configured native saved suite, functional gain or saved-helper application is established here.
The independent evaluator criteria/cases/scorers remain unchanged; this review does not self-review their implementation.
Current authority, alias/project, forgetting/retention and guarded application remain separate integration requirements and cannot be inferred from a matching static target alone.
Whole project goal and full AIDE² remain active; no general privacy, superiority or efficiency claim.
